scenes.heading: Pricing coaching and consulting: hourly, packages, or retainers

sents.d: Pricing coaching and consulting: hourly, packages, or retainers
Each pricing model changes how clients experience commitment and value.
Hourly pricing is simple to understand but can create a transactional feel and sometimes discourages clients from reaching out between sessions when they most need support.

Package pricing (a set number of sessions over a defined period, sold as one commitment) tends to increase client follow-through and results, since both sides are committed to the process rather than deciding session-by-session.

Retainer pricing (ongoing monthly access, often used more in consulting than 1:1 coaching) works well for clients with an ongoing rather than time-limited need, and provides more predictable income than one-off engagements.

take: Sell packages or retainers rather than single hours.
